_note: 18.6.4 = Android-only fix release (iOS stays 18.6.3). Ads no longer freeze with no close button (WebView.pauseTimers froze the ad's own countdown), a leaderboard tap signs in to Play Games instead of doing nothing, no Google sign-in sheet on every launch, Google Mobile Ads SDK 23.6.0 -> 25.5.0. Play Games sign-in also needs the app-signing-key credential in Play Console (server side). Play only, 500 chars/locale.
en-US:
Android fixes for smoother flights:
- Ads now run to the end and close properly. No more getting stuck on a frozen ad.
- Leaderboard and achievements: tap the leaderboard icon to sign in with Play Games and see where you stand.
- No sign-in prompt every time you open the game.
- Fresh ad engine under the hood.

es-MX:
Correcciones para Android:
- Los anuncios ahora llegan al final y se cierran bien. Se acabó quedarse atrapado en un anuncio congelado.

de-DE:
